5254-7741-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-7741-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

252-728-4871.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2523-2869-4247.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2523-2869-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

5078-7692-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Shuri.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

2021-2060-4772-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2034-3755-4885-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-2122-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Mindless Automaton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1987-2187-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-1129-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-5295.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5870-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5870-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-2438-5434.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2173-4616-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1379-2388-4428-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
1379-2388-4428-6587.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1558-2557-2638-4231-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-2638-4231-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1558-3147-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3147-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

104-3188-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3188-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1379-3259-5953-6965.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-5953-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-5953-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

101-1805-4067-6281.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

826-2178-2438-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5231-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5231-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-5231-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

339-677-1849-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4613-4968-6843-6861.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Sawhorn Nemesis.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

777-4013-4659-5004-6643.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

141-6476-6798.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-6476-6798.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2634-4036-4668-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
2634-4036-4668-5195.notes: The amount of mana needed to start can be reduced if opponents have drawn cards this turn due to Heliod.

273-1202-4763-6068.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, targeting Koll.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

428-1694-2736-3908.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-1694-2736-3908.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2719-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

225-5414-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
225-5414-5720-5721.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for the remaining triggers.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

457-3525-5328.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
457-3525-5328.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Attentive Sunscribe, adding {U}.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

341-678-1872.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1980-2989-3664-5261.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Burst of Energy without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Burst of Energy, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Burst of Energies, untapping Isochron Scepter and Lotus Field.
Repeat.

575-1207-1315.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-1315.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

174-570-1636-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a black permanent.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
174-570-1636-4050.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

614-1987-2427-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
